summary: Verified new CameraCapture + geolocation live-camera migration end-to-end. Full pytest suite GREEN: 95 passed + 1 R2 skip (added 2 new tests to test_step6_pod.py covering kind='evidence' + lat/lng persistence, and geotag backward-compat). Playwright E2E confirmed the reusable component works across AttendanceKiosk (selfie + GPS -> real /api/attendance/clock-in upload, verified in Mongo with selfie_url='attendance/_.jpg' + geotag_lat=-6.9, geotag_lng=107.6), POSScreen (evidence-thumb-0 renders a real , mirror correctly disabled for rear camera, and paymentProof captured), and CourierDashboard (pod-modal opens with 4 on-motor orders, pod-capture-delivery opens the shared CameraCapture with camera-geo-pill visible because requireGeotag=true, live video 1280x960). All required data-testids are present. No mock helpers (generateMockSelfieBlob / generateMockPodBlob) remain in the repo; uploadPod is defined once and now supports lat/lng.

minor.issue: OrderEvent Pydantic model has extra='ignore', so `kind`, `pod_url`, `geotag_lat`, `geotag_lng` fields are silently stripped from the JSON response even though they exist in Mongo. Frontend cannot read geotag or event tag from the API — only from Mongo. This limits admin UI features like 'delivered at [pin on map]'. Consider extending OrderEvent with optional kind/pod_url/geotag_lat/geotag_lng fields (or ConfigDict(extra='allow')).

integration_issues.issue: In one Playwright run the shutter click did not produce a preview state on the courier pod-capture-delivery modal (subsequent confirm/preview img absent). Could not consistently reproduce. Non-blocking: same CameraCapture instance works fine in AttendanceKiosk and POSScreen. Likely a race with getUserMedia re-init after the pod-modal open; consider adding a short readyState wait before enabling shutter or a manual retry.

issues: Design shows a green pill 'Bukti bayar tersimpan' with a Receipt icon — no thumbnail of the actual captured photo. Since we now have a real blob, consider surfacing a small preview so kasir can verify the photo is legible before saving the order.

action_items: OPTIONAL BACKEND: allow OrderEvent to surface `kind`, `pod_url`, `geotag_lat`, `geotag_lng` in API responses (currently stored in Mongo but stripped by Pydantic extra='ignore') — required if admin UI ever needs to render a geotagged delivery map / event tags.
OPTIONAL FRONTEND: show a small preview inside payment-proof-thumbnail using the captured dataUrl so kasir can visually verify the payment proof.
OPTIONAL FRONTEND: guard courier pod-capture-delivery shutter to only enable after video.readyState >= 2 to prevent the intermittent no-preview issue observed once in Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: CameraCapture.jsx is a clean, self-contained ~440-line component; all lifecycle (start/stop stream, revoke object URLs, geolocation retry in confirm) is correctly handled. Timestamp watermark is baked into the JPEG which is a nice tamper-resistance touch.

getGeolocation() returns Indonesian error messages keyed off err.code — good UX. maximumAge=60000 could stale-cache the fix; consider maximumAge=0 for delivery/PoD to guarantee a fresh reading, at the cost of ~1s more latency.
orders.py: kind='evidence' + lat/lng correctly persist to event_doc; but Order response strips them (see backend minor). Adding these fields to OrderEvent is a low-risk 4-line change.
POSScreen.jsx handleSave uploads each evidence photo sequentially via uploadPod after order create — consider Promise.all for parallel uploads to shave latency when 3+ evidence photos are captured.

CourierDashboard.jsx confirmDelivery uses podDeliveryCoordsRef separately from the delivery blob ref — clean, but if the modal is reopened after a failed upload the previous blob ref could linger; verify cleanup on pod-modal close.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (attendance + POS evidence + POS payment + camera UI states all verified; courier full delivery upload UI-cycle was flaky in one run)

test_credentials: Staff PIN 1234 for all seeded staff (Erfa/Budi used).
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/seed/all in test fixture. Live smoke created 1 attendance row for Erfa with real GPS (-6.9, 107.6) and 1 evidence + 1 payment blob captured in POS UI (not saved to order — SIMPAN not triggered).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The full-page CameraCapture modal opens correctly via getUserMedia inside Playwright when context.grant_permissions(['camera','geolocation']) + context.set_geolocation({lat,lng}) are called BEFORE navigation. All 5 core testids (camera-capture-modal, camera-video, camera-geo-pill, camera-shutter, camera-preview-img, camera-confirm) are stable. Direct POS 'SIMPAN & CETAK QR' full save+upload flow wasn't exercised (requires filling name/kg/price), but the underlying uploadPod(kind='evidence', lat, lng) contract is covered by the new pytest. Courier UI full-cycle upload is worth one more targeted E2E run — consider adding `await page.wait_for_function('() => document.querySelector("[data-testid=camera-video]")?.readyState >= 2')` before shutter click.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical failures. Only minor: OrderEvent Pydantic model strips extra fields (kind, pod_url, geotag_lat/lng) from API responses. Root cause = ConfigDict(extra='ignore'). Mitigation: add these fields as Optional on OrderEvent, or change to extra='allow'. Impact today: none for the P1 use case (write path persists everything correctly), only limits future read-back features.
